nodes.label: ams_error module (AMS error abstraction)
nodes.rationale: Sole owner of the AMS_ERROR GPIO with three latch levels (clearable / latched / power-cycle-only); pin state recomputed only inside Trigger/Clear, never periodically, so nothing can fight the latch — designed to kill bug 0.2 where IDLE unconditionally cleared the pin every 50 ms. Reuses FaultCode_t as reason (no parallel enum), which also kills the dead ErrorCode_t in brain.h.

nodes.label: ams_protection module (protection policy layer)
nodes.rationale: Owns all threshold checks, debounce, state-dependent limits, SDC read and cross-checks; never writes GPIO or CAN. Data producers (adBms_Application, isa_ivt-s, analog_readings, precharge feedbacks, PC7) never make policy decisions; fault_manager stays a passive registry — severity policy is precisely the gap this layer fills.

nodes.label: AmsProtectionConfig_t threshold accessor
nodes.rationale: Single accessor pattern (compiled defaults now, EEPROM later) fixes the duplicated-thresholds problem: compile-time SAFETY_* macros vs EEPROM masterCfg values were two sources of truth. Accessor never exposes anything but defaults-or-validated, so uninitialized thresholds are structurally impossible; per-field range validation rejects the whole struct on any out-of-range value.

nodes.label: SDC monitoring on PC7 (MCU_SDC_FB)
nodes.rationale: PC7 is already a GPIO input but never read; FAULT_SDC_TRIGGERED exists and is never raised. Polled at 1 ms with a 20 ms integrator debounce instead of EXTI: deterministic debounce, no extra interrupt load, rejects contact bounce and ignition noise while still beating human-scale reaction. Severity is state-dependent, culminating in power-cycle-only when SDC drops during HV_ON — a scrutineering-grade event that software self-recovery would mask.

nodes.label: HV clear-refusal rule
nodes.rationale: AMS_Error_Clear refuses any clear while HV is on. IsHvOn must be conservative: HV counts as ON from SWITCH_HVNEG entry until KILL/WRONG has verified (not merely commanded) all contactors open, and a stuck contactor with AIR+ feedback active still counts as HV present — erring toward refusing clears is the safe direction.

nodes.label: Power-cycle-only latch
nodes.rationale: A static bool zeroed only by .bss init at boot; grep-enforceable rule that no code ever writes false to it. Deliberately not stored in EEPROM or RTC backup registers because a genuine power cycle must clear it while backup domain survives resets that should clear it. A WWDG reset re-zeroing the latch is accepted since the watchdog fault is re-raised at boot; optional 0xDEAD5DC1 magic word detects stray memory writes.

nodes.label: BMS_SafetyCheck migration out of CAN TX
nodes.rationale: BMS_SafetyCheck lives in adbms_to_CAN.c and runs only in IDLE/CHARGING on the 250 ms CAN/UI flag, leaving zero OV/UV/OT supervision while BALANCING and during precharge/HV_ON. The migrated AMS_Protection_EvaluateAdbmsMeasurements rides the measurement cadence (called at ADBMS state-machine sync points, including end of BAL_CYCLE_READ_AVG) so it never judges stale data and closes the balancing hole. Load-bearing behaviors kept verbatim: PEC-skip, 0x8000 negative-cell sentinel maps to open-wire not UV, boot warmup skip, NTC 1.99/149 C open-short window, S4 NTC3/NTC4 known-open hardware.

nodes.label: IVT-S current protection
nodes.rationale: IVT-S getters, staleness check and error-frame parsing exist but feed no decision that opens contactors or blocks precharge. Staleness rule: any value older than 3x cycle time (300 ms) is invalid and dependent checks fail safe rather than pass silently — designed to make the current return-true stubs impossible to recreate. Analog ams_master_current is used only as a coarse plausibility cross-check; two new fault codes (FAULT_OVERCURRENT_DISCHARGE/CHARGE) go at the enum tail.

nodes.label: Precharge / HV_ON safety integration
nodes.rationale: precharge.c keeps sequencing but asks ams_protection at every decision point (PrechargeAllowed gate, cap-charge current and bus-rise checks every 100 ms, stub replacements for VERIFY_CURRENT/VERIFY_BUS_VOLT, ms-based HV_ON supervision replacing the skip_ticks loop counter). bypassChecks/bypassDischarge remain honored only for contactor-feedback checks (their PCB ground-sharing purpose) and must not bypass current/voltage/SDC protection — a test-bench flag that silently disables electrical protection is how packs die.

nodes.label: Single choke-point escalation cascade
nodes.rationale: One internal escalate() owns the whole cascade (RAISE_ERROR, state-aware severity lookup, AMS_Error_Trigger, per-state side effects, printfDebug one-shot) so no check ever hand-rolls its own consequences — hand-rolled consequences are how the IDLE-clears-the-pin class of bug happened.

nodes.label: IDLE clears AMS_ERROR pin bug (finding 0.2)
nodes.rationale: Raw HAL_GPIO_WritePin calls on AMS_ERROR are scattered across brain_start, IDLE and STARTUP cases with nothing arbitrating; IDLE resets the pin every 50 ms unconditionally, silently un-latching the hardware error line after any protection sets it — called the single most dangerous pattern in the codebase.
